channel.title: Learn Korean Daily
channel.description: Everyday Korean for K-drama fans and curious learners.

item.title: 안녕히 가세요 vs 안녕히 계세요: Saying Goodbye in Korean
item.description: Why Korean has two polite goodbyes, who says 안녕히 가세요 and who says 안녕히 계세요, and what the National Institute of Korean Language says about tricky cases.

item.title: 은/는 vs 이/가: Korean Topic and Subject Particles Explained
item.description: When to use 은/는 and when to use 이/가 in Korean, how batchim decides the form, and what the Standard Korean Dictionary says each particle does.

item.title: Common Korean Phrases You Hear in K-Dramas
item.description: Five short Korean phrases that show up constantly in K-dramas, explained with meaning, politeness level, and how they are actually used in daily speech.

item.title: Korean Speech Levels, When to Use Haeyo vs Hamnida
item.description: The official difference between Korean's haeyo and hamnida speech endings, based on the National Institute of Korean Language's own definitions.

item.title: Learn Hangul Consonants and Vowels in One Sitting
item.description: A beginner-friendly walkthrough of the ten basic Hangul consonants and six basic vowels, with the history behind the alphabet's design.

item.title: Native Korean Numbers vs Sino-Korean Numbers, and When to Use Which
item.description: How Korean's two parallel number systems actually split by use case and by size, based on guidance from Korea's National Institute of Korean Language.
